items.title: 蘋果的人工智慧投資與大型科技支出趨勢背道而馳
items.originalTitle: Apple’s AI investment bucks big tech spending trend
items.originalSummary: Apple reduced its payments for property, plant and equipment — a measure of capital expenditures — by 29% in fiscal 2026 even as it increased research and development spending, according to earnings results released Monday . The iPhone maker's research and development expenses rose 32% to $45.8 billion in fiscal 2026, as the company boosts its AI investments. "We continue to significantly increase our overall investments in AI while continuing to invest in the product roadmap," Apple CFO Kevan Parekh said during a Monday earnings call .

investorBrief.event: 根據週一發布的財報，儘管蘋果增加了研發支出，但它在 2026 財年將其用於財產、廠房和設備的支出（資本支出的衡量標準）減少了 29%。隨著該公司加大人工智慧投資，2026 財年這家 iPhone 製造商的研發費用增加了 32%，達到 458 億美元。蘋果財務長凱萬·帕雷克 (Kevan Parekh) 在一次發布會上表示：“我們將繼續大幅增加對人工智慧的整體投資，同時繼續投資於產品路線圖。”
investorBrief.why: 這會直接影響市場對未來營收、EPS 與估值的預期。投資上比已公布的單季數字更重要的是公司接下來的財測方向、毛利與需求能見度。

items.originalTitle: Marvell stock maintained at Buy by UBS on Lumentum acquisition
items.originalSummary: Marvell Technology has agreed to acquire optical components manufacturer Lumentum Holdings in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $115 billion, including debt, marking one of the largest technology acquisitions of the year and a major wager on continued investment in artificial intelligence infrastructure. The agreement, announced Monday, would bring together Marvell’s custom semiconductor and networking operations with Lumentum’s optical technologies, which enable high-speed communication between processors and servers in large data centers, according to Reuters. The acquisition would also strengthen Marvell’s position against Broadcom Inc., a leading supplier of custom chips and networking equipment to major cloud computing companies. Under the terms of the agreement, Lumentum shareholders will receive 4.5 Marvell shares for each share they hold, equivalent to approximately $1,132 per Lumentum share. The offer represents a 23.9% premium to Lumentum’s unaffected closing price on October 28, Reuters reported. The transaction assigns Lumentum an equity value of roughly $102.54 billion. Following completion, existing Marvell investors would control approximately 67% of the combined company, while Lumentum shareholders would own the remaining 33%. Both companies’ boards have unanimously approved the transaction, which is expected to close during the first half of 2028, subject to regulatory and other customary approvals. The proposed combination reflects a broader shift in artificial intelligence computing, where the ability to transfer information efficiently between thousands of processors has become increasingly important. As technology companies expand their AI systems, conventional electrical connections face growing limitations in bandwidth, energy consumption and distance. Optical technologies, which transmit information using light, are emerging as a critical component of next-generation data center architecture. Marvell Chief Executive Officer Matt Murphy described the transition toward optical connectivity as a significant long-term opportunity, according to Reuters. Murphy is expected to remain chairman and chief executive of the combined company. Marvell estimates that the acquisition would increase the combined company’s total addressable market to approximately $550 billion.

items.originalTitle: Marvell's $115 Billion Lumentum Bet Draws Two Downgrades and a Halved Price Target
items.originalSummary: Marvell Technology has agreed to acquire optical components manufacturer Lumentum Holdings in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $115 billion, including debt, marking one of the largest technology acquisitions of the year and a major wager on continued investment in artificial intelligence infrastructure. The agreement, announced Monday, would bring together Marvell’s custom semiconductor and networking operations with Lumentum’s optical technologies, which enable high-speed communication between processors and servers in large data centers, according to Reuters. The acquisition would also strengthen Marvell’s position against Broadcom Inc., a leading supplier of custom chips and networking equipment to major cloud computing companies. Under the terms of the agreement, Lumentum shareholders will receive 4.5 Marvell shares for each share they hold, equivalent to approximately $1,132 per Lumentum share. The offer represents a 23.9% premium to Lumentum’s unaffected closing price on October 28, Reuters reported. The transaction assigns Lumentum an equity value of roughly $102.54 billion. Following completion, existing Marvell investors would control approximately 67% of the combined company, while Lumentum shareholders would own the remaining 33%. Both companies’ boards have unanimously approved the transaction, which is expected to close during the first half of 2028, subject to regulatory and other customary approvals. The proposed combination reflects a broader shift in artificial intelligence computing, where the ability to transfer information efficiently between thousands of processors has become increasingly important. As technology companies expand their AI systems, conventional electrical connections face growing limitations in bandwidth, energy consumption and distance. Optical technologies, which transmit information using light, are emerging as a critical component of next-generation data center architecture. Marvell Chief Executive Officer Matt Murphy described the transition toward optical connectivity as a significant long-term opportunity, according to Reuters. Murphy is expected to remain chairman and chief executive of the combined company. Marvell estimates that the acquisition would increase the combined company’s total addressable market to approximately $550 billion.

items.originalSummary: Ichor Holdings, Ltd. (NASDAQ: ICHR), a leader in the design, engineering, and manufacturing of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components for semiconductor capital equipment, today announced third quarter 2026 financial results.Third quarter 2026 highlights:Revenue of $328.7 million, up 12% compared to Q2 2026 and up 37% compared to Q3 2025;Gross margin of 15.8% on a GAAP basis and 16.0% on a non‑GAAP basis; andEarnings per share of $0.55 on a GAAP basis and $0.63 on a non-GAAP basis.“We are pleased to report another quarter of strong growth and expanding profitability, as the strategic priorities we laid out a year ago continue to translate into results,” commented Phil Barros, Ichor’s CEO. “We are executing an exceptionally steep revenue ramp, with third-quarter revenues up nearly 50% from the fourth quarter of 2025. This unprecedented three-quarter revenue increase for Ichor, executed in parallel with three straight quarters of meaningful gross margin expansion, is driving strong earnings leverage during what we believe are still the early stages of the historic semiconductor cycle underway. The ongoing realignment of our global footprint into our volume manufacturing sites and the steady increase in proprietary Ichor content are delivering the operating model improvements we planned."“Customer demand remains robust, with visibility extending well into 2027,” continued Mr. Barros. “Our outlook for the fourth quarter indicates continued sequential growth in revenues, gross margin, and earnings per share. We are investing to support our customers’ growth well beyond this year, and we expect the structural improvements in our operating model will help further earnings leverage as revenues continue to ramp.” Q3 2026 Q2 2026 Q3 2025 (dollars in thousands, except per share amounts)U.S. GAAP Financial Results: Net sales$328,699 $294,784 $239,296 Gross margin 15.8% 13.9% 4.6%Operating margin 6.9% 2.4% (8.1)%Net income (loss)$20,947 $998 $(22,853)Diluted EPS$0.55 $0.03 $(0.67) Q3 2026 Q2 2026 Q3 2025 (dollars in thousands, except per share amounts)Non-GAAP Financial Results: Gross margin 16.0% 14.1% 5.1%Operating margin 8.6% 5.5% (4.8)%Net income (loss)$24,218 $12,172 $(14,411)Diluted EPS$0.63 $0.34 $(0.42)U.S. GAAP Financial Results OverviewFor the third quarter of 2026, revenue was $328.7 million, net income was $20.9 million, and diluted earnings per share (“diluted EPS”) was $0.55. This compares to revenue of $294.8 million and $239.3 million, net income (loss) of $1.0 million and $(22.9) million, and diluted EPS of $0.03 and $(0.67), for the second quarter of 2026 and third quarter of 2025, respectively.Non-GAAP Financial Results OverviewFor the third quarter of 2026, non-GAAP net income was $24.2 million and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $0.63. This compares to non-GAAP net income (loss) of $12.2 million and $(14.4) million, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.34 and $(0.42), for the second quarter of 2026 and third quarter of 2025, respectively.Fourth Quarter 2026 Financial OutlookFor the fourth quarter of 2026, we expect the following: Low-End Mid-Point High-EndRevenue$345 million $355 million $365 millionGAAP diluted EPS$0.50 $0.55 $0.60

historyItems.title: 由人工智慧驅動Boom、Marvell 和 Lumentum 宣布價值 1,150 億美元的合併
historyItems.summary: Marvell Technology 週一宣布以 1,150 億美元的股票互換收購 Lumentum Holdings，這是一項重大賭注，押注於一種名為光網路的技術對於人工智慧資料中心的建設至關重要。兩家矽谷公司之間的交易（其中包括 Lumentum 的債務）將成為上市科技公司之間有史以來規模最大的交易。 Marvell 生產一系列用於網路和人工智慧的晶片。自 Matthew Murphy 2016 年加入公司擔任執行長以來，這家擁有 31 年歷史的公司一直透過收購實現快速發展。
historyItems.originalTitle: Driven by A.I. Boom, Marvell and Lumentum Announce $115 Billion Merger
historyItems.originalSummary: Marvell Technology on Monday announced a $115 billion stock swap to buy Lumentum Holdings, in a major bet that a technology known as optical networking will be crucial to the build-out of data centers for artificial intelligence. The transaction between the two Silicon Valley companies, which includes Lumentum’s debt, would rank as the largest ever by value between publicly held tech companies. Marvell makes an array of chips for networking and A.I. The 31-year-old company has been growing rapidly by acquisition since Matthew Murphy joined it as chief executive in 2016. Lumentum makes lasers and a series of other chips and components that use light to transmit data signals, a mainstay of long-distance communications known as optical networking, which is increasingly used inside data centers.

historyItems.title: 投資者對 IBM (IBM) 人工智慧產品發布有何反應
historyItems.summary: 國際商業機器公司 (International Business Machines) 延續其作為美國公開賽官方人工智慧和雲端合作夥伴的角色直至 2031 年，並推出了新的人工智慧代理、安全和基礎設施工具，同時公佈的 2026 年第三季度收入為 171.03 億美元，淨利潤為 21.90 億美元。 IBM 正在快速成長的量子運算和小語言模型市場中佔據一席之地，同時透過 watsonx Orchestrate 和 HashiCorp Vault 整合等產品加強對 AI 代理的控制，這些產品將新興技術直接與企業級治理和合規性需求聯繫起來。接下來，焦點轉向 IBM 關於混合雲、人工智慧和量子的投資敘事如何受到其新的人工智慧代理治理所推動的影響。
historyItems.originalTitle: How Investors Are Reacting To IBM (IBM) AI Product Launches
historyItems.originalSummary: International Business Machines renewed its role as the US Open's Official AI and Cloud Partner through 2031 and rolled out new AI agent, security and infrastructure tools alongside reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$17,103 million and net income of US$2,190 million. IBM is being profiled in fast growing quantum computing and small language model markets while tightening control over AI agents through products like watsonx Orchestrate and HashiCorp Vault integrations, which ties emerging technologies directly to enterprise-grade governance and compliance needs. Next, the focus turns to how IBM's investment narrative around hybrid cloud, AI and quantum is affected by its new AI agent governance push.

historyItems.originalSummary: Bristol Gate Capital Partners , an investment management company, published its Q3 2026 investor letter for the "US Equity Strategy". The letter can be downloaded here . The US Equity Strategy lagged the S&P 500 (+2.3%) in Q3 2026, as declines in industrial and semiconductor-equipment holdings weighed against gains in tech. Portfolio fundamentals were solid in the quarter, with 21 out of 22 holdings exceeding earnings forecasts, six raising guidance, and several boosting dividends. Key contributors included Microsoft, Cintas, and McKesson, while KLA, Applied Materials, and GE Aerospace negatively impacted performance. Bristol Gate's portfolio remains positioned for long-term compounding via robust balance sheets and cash-flow-funded dividend growth, providing resilience against high interest rates, top-heavy market concentration, and AI credit friction. historyItems.title: FORM 與 COHU：哪種半導體測試股票比較值得買？
historyItems.summary: FormFactor FORM 和 Cohu COHU 是半導體測試設備提供商，受益於人工智慧 (AI) 基礎設施投資的加速、半導體複雜性的增加、對高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 的需求不斷增長以及先進封裝技術的廣泛採用。然而，他們的核心產品差異很大。 FormFactor 專注於先進晶圓級探針卡、MEMS 技術和光子測試解決方案，為代工廠、邏輯和記憶體製造商提供服務。相較之下，Cohu 專注於高效能處理器和功率元件的自動化測試處理器、先進熱管理、半導體偵測、測試介面和自動化測試設備。
historyItems.originalTitle: FORM vs. COHU: Which Semiconductor Testing Stock is a Better Buy?
historyItems.originalSummary: FormFactor FORM and Cohu COHU are semiconductor testing equipment providers benefiting from accelerating artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure investments, increasing semiconductor complexity, growing demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and expanding adoption of advanced packaging technologies. However, their core offerings differ significantly. FormFactor specializes in advanced wafer-level probe cards, MEMS technologies and photonics testing solutions, serving foundry, logic and memory manufacturers. In contrast, Cohu focuses on automated test handlers, advanced thermal management, semiconductor inspection, test interfaces and automated test equipment for high-performance processors and power devices. FORM or COHU, which is a better buy currently?

historyItems.originalTitle: Intel Plunges After PC Slump and Supply Snags Hurt Outlook
historyItems.originalSummary: [SAN FRANCISCO] Intel plunged in late trading after its revenue forecast missed analysts’ estimates, hurt by sputtering demand for PC processors and supply chain problems with its lucrative data centre components. Sales in the fourth quarter will be US$15 billion to US$16 billion, the company said on Thursday (Oct 29) in a statement. Analysts, on average, estimated US$17 billion and some projections topped US$18 billion, according to data compiled by Bloomberg. Profit will be US$0.25 a share in the quarter, excluding certain items. Wall Street was projecting adjusted earnings of US$0.43 a share.

historyItems.originalTitle: Intel tops Q3 earnings estimates, but falls short of Q4 outlook on sluggish PC sales as stock plunges 20%
historyItems.originalSummary: Intel Corporation INTC reported solid third-quarter 2026 results, with adjusted earnings and revenues beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate. Strong demand for server processors, driven by artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure investments, supported top-line growth despite weakness in the PC market. Non-GAAP earnings surged 126.1% year over year to 52 cents per share, surpassing the consensus estimate of 39 cents by 33.33%. Revenues increased 20.9% to $16.51 billion, beating the consensus estimate of $16.44 billion by 0.44%. Data Center and AI revenues jumped 78% year over year, reflecting strong demand across hyperscale, enterprise and neo-cloud customers. However, a soft fourth-quarter outlook overshadowed the feel-good factor for investors and shares plunged more than 25% in pre-market trading.

historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX Supplier STMicroelectronics Forecasts Strong Sales on AI, Satellite Boost
historyItems.originalSummary: By Mauro Orru STMicroelectronics projected robust sales growth for the year as the build-out of data centers to power artificial-intelligence models and the deployment of satellites to provide connectivity services fuel demand for semiconductors. The European chip maker, which counts Apple and Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX among its clients, said 2026 revenue should grow nearly 23% on year to roughly $14.5 billion. Meanwhile, its gross margin--a closely watched measure of pricing power--should increase to about 36.4% from 33.9% last year. The company had refrained from providing detailed annual guidance until now , as it embarks on the final quarter, gaining better visibility into what is driving demand. It expects sales of about $4.15 billion this quarter compared with $3.33 billion a year earlier, above a Visible Alpha forecast of nearly $4.12 billion. Its annual sales projection is also above a Visible Alpha forecast of $14.41 billion. Chief Executive Jean-Marc Chery singled out data centers and satellites as key drivers for growth this year. Like other chip makers, STMicroelectronics is reaping the benefits of hundreds of billions of dollars in spending commitments from some of the world's largest tech groups to build out AI infrastructure. STMicroelectronics stock has nearly doubled in value since the year began, riding a wave of investor fervor around AI that lifted global semiconductor stocks. In a sign of how fast demand for chips to power energy-intensive data centers is building up, STMicroelectronics in July projected revenue from data centers above $1 billion in 2026 and well above $2 billion in 2027 compared with prior guidance of about $1 billion and roughly $2 billion, respectively. That marked the second time the company raised its AI forecasts this year. Alongside data centers, space also provides a key revenue stream for STMicroelectronics and other chip makers that supply semiconductors for low-Earth-orbit satellite constellations. The company expects well above $3 billion in revenue between 2026 and 2028 for the supply of equipment to be used in space, a forecast that for now excludes potential benefits from orbital data centers. Low Earth-orbit satellite networks are closer to Earth than traditional constellations, making them ideal to beam low-latency broadband directly to smartphones in parts of the world where cell towers are unavailable. SpaceX's Starlink provides direct-to-device connectivity to users in several countries, including Ukraine, where damage to terrestrial networks because of the war is common. STMicroelectronics had long relied on the automotive industry to generate a significant portion of its sales. Data centers and satellites have allowed the group to diversify its revenue streams and become less tied to carmakers. The auto industry in recent years had slowly been digesting chip inventories it built at the height of the pandemic, weighing on demand for new orders in a blow to STMicroelectronics. historyItems.originalTitle: Intel Shares Plunge More Than 20% on Weak PC-Market Outlook

historyItems.summary: Aehr Test Systems (AEHR) 剛剛將前 Meta 基礎設施領導者 Vijay Rao 納入其董事會，將三十年的人工智慧、資料中心和半導體經驗帶入公司的半導體測試和老化重點中。 Aehr Test Systems 最近的交易很艱難，儘管今年迄今的股價回報率上漲了 148%，一年的股東總回報率為 111%，但其股價在過去一個月內下跌了約 45%，在 90 天內下跌了約 31%。
historyItems.originalTitle: Aehr Test Systems Appoints Former Meta Executive Vijay Rao to Board of Directors
historyItems.originalSummary: Aehr Test Systems (AEHR) just added former Meta infrastructure leader Vijay Rao to its Board of Directors, bringing three decades of AI, data center, and semiconductor experience into the company's semiconductor test and burn-in focus. Recent trading has been rough for Aehr Test Systems, with the share price down about 45% over the past month and around 31% over 90 days, even though the year to date share price return is up 148% and the 1 year total shareholder return is 111%. This mix of sharp short term declines and very strong multi year total shareholder returns, including 124% over three years and 113% over five, points to a stock where expectations and perceived risk around its semiconductor testing opportunity are being reset even as interest in its longer run story remains significant.

historyItems.originalTitle: Teradyne (TER) Dropped, So What Is Behind The Latest Attention?

historyItems.originalTitle: Hackers Exploited Cisco SD-WAN Flaw to Plant Malware Built to Steal Encryption Keys
historyItems.originalSummary: PHP2Shell security flaws now sucessfully exploited in the wild DreamHost forces password resets in ongoing "incident" Kali Linux 2026.3 released with 6 new tools, desktop updates Critical 'HTTP2Shell' Brotli vulnerability triggers emergency patches How to access the Dark Web using the Tor Browser How to enable Kernel-mode Hardware-enforced Stack Protection in Windows 11 How to backup and restore the Windows Registry A newly identified advanced persistent threat (APT) group tracked as UAT-11473 was observed exploiting CVE-2026-20127, an authentication-bypass flaw in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controllers, to deploy a custom malware framework called KeyDrift. CVE-2026-20127 is a max-severity flaw that Cisco patched in February 2026, which allows remote attackers to gain privileged access to Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and Manager and add rogue peers. UAT-8616 has exploited the vulnerability as a zero-day since at least 2023 , and recent research also linked its exploitation to the Chinese Volt Typhoon state-sponsored hacking group.

historyItems.title: 英偉達合作夥伴維諦技術 (Vertiv) 獲利井噴，業績指引強勁，股價飆升
historyItems.summary: 數據中心基礎設施公司 Vertiv Holdings（NYSE：VRT）的股票在 10 月 28 日星期三早盤前的延長交易中經歷了強勁的上漲，從截至發稿時最新的 208.56 美元上漲了 16.13%，接近 242.20 美元。這項舉措是上週稍晚開始的 9% 反彈的延續，導致 VRT 股價在周線圖表上下跌 3.50%，在月線圖表上下跌 14.54%。儘管如此，盤前走勢還是幫助抹去了自 10 月 9 日以來遭受的所有損失。 Vertiv 股價最近的上漲是由於一份特別令人印象深刻的收益報告，該報告顯示該公司在營收和每股盈餘 (EPS) 方面都超出了華爾街的預期。
historyItems.originalTitle: Nvidia Partner Vertiv Soars After Blowout Earnings, Strong Guidance
historyItems.originalSummary: The stock of the data center infrastructure company Vertiv Holdings (NYSE: VRT) experienced a powerful rally in the extended session leading toward the Wednesday, October 28, morning bell, rising 16.13% from $208.56 at the latest close to $242.20 at press time. This move came as a continuation of the 9% recovery that started late last week, which left VRT shares 3.50% in the red on the weekly chart and 14.54% down on the monthly chart. Still, the pre-market move helped erase all losses suffered since October 9. Vertiv stock’s latest upsurge came as a result of a particularly impressive earnings report that showed the company beat Wall Street forecasts in terms of both revenue and earnings-per-share (EPS).

historyItems.summary: 投資管理公司 Burke Wealth Management 發布了 2026 年第三季的「聚焦成長策略」投資者信。您可以在此處下載該信函的副本。該基金在 2026 年第三季取得了強勁的業績，受益於企業軟體的急劇復甦以及市場持續波動期間企業盈利的穩健。該綜合指數扣除費用後的回報率為 10.8%，大大超過標準普爾 500 總回報指數 2.3% 的漲幅，而其年初至今的回報率達到 20.0%，而基準回報率為 12.7%。
historyItems.originalTitle: AI Data Center Supplier Amphenol Jumps On Earnings Beat
historyItems.originalSummary: Burke Wealth Management, an investment management company, released its "Focused Growth Strategy" Q3 2026 investor letter. A copy of the letter can be downloaded here . The fund delivered strong results in the third quarter of 2026, benefiting from a sharp recovery in enterprise software and solid corporate earnings amid continued market volatility. The composite returned 10.8% net of fees, substantially outperforming the S&P 500 Total Return Index's 2.3% gain, while its year-to-date return reached 20.0%, compared with 12.7% for the benchmark. The firm attributed the quarter's strength partly to investors reassessing the long-term value of enterprise software platforms that can securely connect AI models with proprietary business data. Burke believes these platforms can serve as essential AI "harnesses," providing permissions, security, and context for enterprise applications, although it cautions that AI agents could challenge traditional software business models and seat-based pricing. Looking ahead, Burke remains optimistic about the remainder of 2026, citing strong corporate earnings growth and the transition from AI infrastructure investment toward practical applications that may improve productivity and consumer experiences. In addition, please check the Fund's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.

Firm gas turbine backlog rose to 64 gigawatts as more slot reservations converted into signed orders, though new contract signings slowed sharply from the prior quarter. Power segment margins and orders surged while Wind losses widened and Electrification orders dipped. Special Report : See How You Could Qualify for the Fastest Second Citizenship as an American Today (From International Living) GE Vernova (NYSE: GEV) gave investors plenty to like in its third-quarter report , released before the open on Wednesday, Oct. 28. Revenue climbed 27% to $12.6 billion, comfortably ahead of the roughly $12 billion analysts expected, and earnings of $4.81 per share beat the $4.03 consensus. Orders nearly doubled on an organic basis to $29.3 billion, while total backlog grew by $20 billion in a single quarter to $197 billion. Management also raised its 2026 outlook for revenue, margins, and free cash flow, and doubled its share repurchase authorization to $20 billion. Still, the stock slid as much as 6.6% intraday before closing down about 2% for the day, leaving it 27% below its 52-week high. That reaction says a lot. With AI infrastructure stocks under pressure, a bigger backlog alone no longer impresses the market. The more important question is what that backlog is actually made of, and how much of it is turning into firm business. Firm backlog consists of signed equipment orders. Slot reservation agreements hold a customer’s place in the production line, but they aren’t orders yet. As of June 30, the company had 53 GW of firm backlog and 63 GW of slot reservations. In the third quarter, it converted 13 GW of reservations into firm orders, up from 10 GW the prior quarter, while shipping 5 GW of equipment. That pushed firm backlog up to 64 GW and brought reservations down to 58 GW, for 122 GW under contract in total. Notably, that’s the shift management pointed to last quarter , with firm orders now outweighing reservations. The company also raised its year-end goal to at least 130 GW under contract, up from 125 GW. Production Is Keeping Pace Of course, converting reservations only matters if GE Vernova can actually build the turbines. historyItems.originalSummary: Vice President of Investor Relations - Michael Lapides Operator: Good day, ladies and gentlemen, and welcome to GE Vernova's Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call. historyItems.summary: 亞馬遜執行長安迪賈西 (Andy Jassy) 表示，AWS 已為 2027 年的主要客戶承諾預訂了大部分運算能力，其中一些承諾延續到 2028 年。 Jassy 在 10 月 23 日的 a16z Show 播客中表示，儘管亞馬遜計劃在 2026 年花費約 2,200 億美元的資本支出，但 AWS 仍難以滿足人工智慧開發人員和企業客戶的需求。 「2027 年大部分都已售罄，」Jassy 表示，並補充說「2028 年很大一部分已售罄。」該公司2026年的產能也已全部投入，不包括為按需服務預留的資源。 Jassy 澄清說，這些承諾主要涉及大量運算能力的分配，而不是所有 AWS 服務。
historyItems.originalTitle: Amazon cloud capacity largely sold out through 2027, CEO Jassy says
historyItems.originalSummary: AWS has largely booked its computing capacity for major customer commitments in 2027, with some commitments extending into 2028, according to Amazon CEO Andy Jassy. Speaking on the a16z Show podcast on October 23, Jassy said AWS was struggling to meet demand from AI developers and enterprise customers despite Amazon’s plans to spend approximately $220 billion on capital expenditure in 2026. “2027 is largely sold out,” Jassy said, adding that “a good chunk of 2028 is sold out.” The company’s capacity for 2026 has also been fully committed, excluding resources reserved for on-demand services. Jassy clarified that the commitments primarily concern large allocations of computing capacity rather than all AWS services. The company continues to reserve resources for on-demand workloads through Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) and its managed generative AI service, Amazon Bedrock. Amazon has not disclosed the exact amount of computing capacity committed for 2027 and 2028 or how much remains available for on-demand customers. Jassy identified data centre availability, electricity, and memory supply as constraints on AWS’s ability to expand computing capacity. He said shortages affecting different infrastructure components would continue beyond 2027. Memory shortages are also affecting how AWS allocates resources between AI and conventional cloud workloads. AI accelerators use high-bandwidth memory (HBM), while conventional servers typically rely on other forms of dynamic random-access memory (DRAM). Jassy said AWS faces allocation decisions as demand for both AI and non-AI computing services increases. During Amazon’s second-quarter 2026 earnings call, Jassy said data centre spending typically begins about two years before servers can be put into service. Servers and networking equipment are generally purchased only a few months before they are needed. This allows AWS to reduce equipment purchases if customer demand falls short of expectations. Its data centre infrastructure, meanwhile, is designed to remain operational for more than 30 years.

historyItems.originalTitle: Secure keys strengthen protected military satellite communications
historyItems.originalSummary: At any given moment, a U.S. Air Force pilot may be maneuvering an aircraft mid-mission, a U.S. Navy officer resurfacing a submarine after weeks undersea, or a U.S. Army technician offloading drone data in a combat zone. Each operation depends on satellite communications (satcom) and, specifically, on cryptographic keys that allow terminals to communicate securely while keeping adversaries locked out. At the scale of modern operations, managing these keys is a technical challenge. Every terminal needs to have the right keys at the right time, quickly and securely, and if any keys are compromised, they need to be refreshed without leaving out devices that may be offline, disconnected, or under attack. MIT Lincoln Laboratory researchers have now solved this challenge with the Protected Anti-Jam Tactical Satcom (PATS) Key Management System (KMS) Prototype. This new architecture enables keys to refresh rapidly across terminals dispersed worldwide, even in contested or bandwidth-constrained environments. "We're enabling the nation to achieve highly assured, highly available communications. Even when adversaries know where forces are operating and are trying to stop them from communicating, they're unable to do so, because we've built in smarts across this entire system to keep talking," says Joseph Sobchuk, a principal investigator of the PATS KMS Prototype program and researcher in the Secure Resilient Systems and Technology Group . This architecture is being adopted as the cryptographic backbone of the U.S. Space Force's next-generation satcom system, PATS. The KMS Prototype serves as the gold-standard reference implementation for the industry-built operational KMS, which will be integrated across the PATS ecosystem, encompassing satellites, user terminals on military platforms, and ground-based communication hubs. Developed under sponsorship of the Space Force's Space Systems Command (SSC), the KMS Prototype reflects Lincoln Laboratory's end-to-end approach to technology development, from shaping the core key-management concepts to putting them into practice in a prototype to transitioning a technical baseline to government and industry. For this transitioned innovation, the SSC and Lincoln Laboratory team received a 2025 R&D 100 Award , recognizing the KMS Prototype among the year's most impactful new technologies. Cryptographic keys are foundational to secure communications. These keys, strings of random characters used by cryptographic algorithms, help protect communications by encrypting data and supporting protected transmission patterns, such as frequency hopping . Without key protection, the communications sent and received by terminals are more susceptible to eavesdropping and interference. Historically, operators manually uploaded keys to terminals before missions. More recently, some systems have supported over-the-air key updates, but bandwidth constraints, security concerns, and operational complexity have limited real-time, wide-scale refresh. historyItems.originalTitle: Snowflake and Oracle Expand Their Partnership to Bring the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to OCI
historyItems.originalSummary: New first-party service gives customers more choice and flexibility to accelerate enterprise AI initiatives and realize business value faster LAS VEGAS, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Oracle AI World -- Oracle and Snowflake (NYSE: SNOW) today announced that Snowflake AI Data Cloud will be available as a native, first-party service on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), further expanding the AI and data capabilities Oracle offers to help organizations accelerate enterprise AI initiatives. By making Snowflake available alongside Oracle's comprehensive portfolio of infrastructure, AI, data, and application services, Oracle will give customers greater flexibility to put their enterprise data to work and drive AI-powered innovation. Customers will be able to purchase and provision the offering directly through Oracle, with simplified pricing and billing, alongside the ability to use Oracle Universal Credits.

historyItems.originalTitle: Google and Oracle are partnering to bring Google TPUs to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
historyItems.originalSummary: OCI will be the first hyperscaler outside Google to offer Google TPUsLAS VEGAS, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Oracle AI World -- Oracle and Google today announced that Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) will be available through Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), marking the first time Google TPUs will be offered on a hyperscale cloud platform outside Google. By bringing Google's purpose-built TPUs to OCI's AI compute portfolio, customers gain the flexibility to match their most demanding workloads with infrastructure designed for near-linear scalability and highly optimized economics. "Different AI workloads have different compute needs," said Mahesh Thiagarajan, president, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Oracle. "Bringing Google TPUs to OCI gives customers access to multiple leading AI compute architectures in one cloud. That choice gives them the flexibility to choose the right infrastructure for the performance, throughput, and economics of each AI workload."Google TPUs are custom accelerators co-designed with open software to power the entire AI lifecycle—from frontier training and large-scale inference to the multi-step reasoning data demands of agentic AI. OCI will provide the power, cooling, and datacenter networking to deploy Google TPUs at scale within its infrastructure."The next generation of AI will require a diverse range of compute," said Amin Vahdat, senior vice president and chief technologist, AI & Infrastructure, Google. "TPUs give customers a powerful, purpose-built option for demanding training and inference workloads. Bringing Google TPUs to OCI will give more organizations access to this technology and greater flexibility in how they build and run their most complex AI applications."More AI Compute Options for Every WorkloadAs models grow and production inference demands increase, the performance and economics of every training run and inference request become increasingly important. Google's TPU architecture is designed to maximize AI processing from each watt of electricity, with fast access to model data and rapid communication between chips.Google TPUs can support large-model training and post-training, including dense and mixture-of-experts models (MoE), as well as production inference for reasoning, agentic, and long-context applications. Customers will be able to choose Google TPUs within OCI, optimized for their workloads, performance requirements, and cost objectives.Drawing on more than a decade of custom AI silicon development, Google's TPU portfolio delivers purpose-built compute optimized for massive machine learning workloads. Google's eighth-generation TPU introduces two purpose-built architectures: TPU 8t for training and TPU 8i for inference. TPU 8t cuts frontier model development cycles from months to weeks, delivering nearly 3x the compute performance per pod over the previous generation, while TPU 8i is designed to handle the iterative work of many specialized agents.Google TPUs on OCI will be available in calendar year 2027, ramping over a multi-year period to meet customer needs.Additional ResourcesLearn more about Oracle C

historyItems.originalTitle: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
historyItems.originalSummary: OpenAI said it is expanding its partnership with Oracle to bring business applications and AI agents into ChatGPT, while also helping power new Oracle offerings, according to an OpenAI announcement published on Oct. 27, 2026. The update extends a relationship that has already moved beyond infrastructure and into enterprise distribution. In its announcement, OpenAI said the companies are working to place Oracle business applications and AI agents inside ChatGPT, and to support new Oracle products through the collaboration. The statement did not include pricing, rollout timing, customer counts or a product launch schedule. The partnership has been building through multiple prior steps. OpenAI said on Aug. 7, 2026 that eligible Oracle Universal Credits can be used to purchase OpenAI API models, Codex and ChatGPT Work through Oracle Marketplace. Oracle also said on Oct. 16, 2026 that its own employees were adopting Enterprise ChatGPT as part of its AI-transformation update, indicating internal use of OpenAI software within the company. The expansion comes against a broader backdrop of joint infrastructure development. Oracle said in a June 11, 2024 announcement with Microsoft and OpenAI that Oracle Cloud Infrastructure would supply additional capacity by extending Microsoft’s Azure AI platform. OpenAI later named Oracle among the initial equity funders in its Jan. 21, 2025 Stargate announcement, which outlined an intention to invest $500 billion in U.S. AI infrastructure over four years. OpenAI then said on July 22, 2025 that it had agreed with Oracle to develop an additional 4.5 gigawatts of U.S. Stargate capacity, taking the total described in that update to more than 5 gigawatts under development and more than 2 million chips. Those figures described planned development, not already completed capacity. Oracle’s current infrastructure page, as of September 2026, said Abilene had delivered 75% of total capacity, while customer delivery at Shackelford and Doña Ana County was scheduled to begin in the first half of 2027. That timeline gives the partnership a physical infrastructure layer, while the new OpenAI announcement points to a broader software and distribution tie-up. There were no verified details in the source material on financial terms, revenue impact, exclusivity, or an official launch date for the new ChatGPT integrations. The timing of any further product rollout remains unknown from the supplied material.

historyItems.originalTitle: Anduril expanding into laptop manufacturing in partnership with Qualcomm

historyItems.originalTitle: Market Rotation Overshadows KLA Corp’s (KLAC) Solid Results and Guidance
historyItems.originalSummary: Renaissance Investment Management, an investment management company, released its Q3 2026 investor letter for "Large Cap Growth Strategy." The letter can be downloaded here . Stocks showed modest gains in Q3, with the S&P 500 up 2.3%. Energy, Technology, and Health Care sectors excelled, while Utilities, Industrials, Real Estate, and Consumer Discretionary lagged. Market breadth was narrow, with many stocks remaining significantly below their 52-week highs. The Russell 1000 Growth returned 0.9%, while large-cap stocks outperformed small-cap. Bonds experienced negative returns as 30-year U.S. Treasury yields rose, influenced by fiscal concerns and geopolitical tensions. The Federal Reserve raised interest rates in response to unexpected economic growth and persistent inflation. S&P 500 earnings soared 52% year-over-year, buoyed by selected mark-to-market gains, with future estimates being upgraded. Free cash flow growth has been mixed due to investments in AI and infrastructure, but broader market prospects are improving. Also, check the Fund's top five holdings to see its best picks for 2026.

historyItems.summary: Meta Platforms Inc. 今天宣布 Nvidia Corp. 和 Advanced Micro Devices Inc. 計劃購買其價值 40 億美元的股票。
historyItems.originalTitle: Nvidia, AMD to invest $4 billion in Meta as tech giants deepen AI partnership
historyItems.originalSummary: Meta Platforms Inc. today announced that Nvidia Corp. and Advanced Micro Devices Inc. plan to buy $4 billion worth of its shares. The chipmakers will purchase the equity as part of an up to $95 billion stock sale that the Facebook parent intends to kick off in the near future. The fundraising initiative will also include the participation of Broadcom Inc. Meta didn’t specify how much the company is investing, but it stated on Monday that Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom together plan to invest $5 billion. That suggests the networking chip giant will buy $1 billion in shares. Nvidia is investing $3 billion as part of a newly expanded partnership that also includes other components. Notably, Meta plans to broaden its use of the chipmaker’s Rubin graphics processing units and Vera central processing units. Companies often deploy the two chips together in Nvidia-designed DGX Vera Rubin NVL72 appliances. Each system includes 72 GPUs and 36 CPUs. Meta also plans to buy more Nvidia networking gear. It will expand its use of the Spectrum-X Ethernet product family, which includes SuperNICs and switches. SuperNICs are chips that connect servers to a data center’s network, while switches coordinate how traffic flows through that network. GPU clusters’ traffic patterns tend to change rapidly. As a result, connectivity bottlenecks sometimes emerge faster than the network can respond to them. Nvidia says that its Spectrum-X Ethernet product series addresses the challenge by checking GPU traffic for anomalies at sub-microsecond time intervals. A microsecond corresponds to one millionth of a second. Another focus of Meta’s planned network investment is Nvidia’s BlueField-4 chip family. The accelerators in the series are designed to speed common networking, storage and cybersecurity tasks. Nvidia will help Meta improve the performance and cost efficiency of its Muse large language model family. The effort will extend to the Facebook parent’s eponymous consumer AI agent. Additionally, Meta plans to explore “collaboration opportunities” related to Nvidia’s recently introduced OpenShell Reference Architecture. It’s a collection of technical resources that makes it easier to run the chipmaker’s OpenShell toolkit. The toolkit runs AI agents in isolated sandboxes designed to mitigate cybersecurity risks. “Nvidia and Meta are expanding our partnership to optimize the computing infrastructure end to end for capable, efficient and secure AI agents, so Muse can empower billions of people to achieve more and pursue greater ambitions,” said Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang. AMD, which will invest $1 billion in Meta, today revealed that the Facebook parent has adopted its Helios rack design. Helios contains 72 GPUs much like the DGX Vera Rubin NVL72. It’s based on AMD’s latest Instinct MI450 graphics card architecture, Epyc CPUs and Pensando data processing units, which are the chipmaker’s answer to the BlueField-4.

historyItems.originalTitle: Introducing Cisco Model Foundry: Bringing AI to our partners
historyItems.originalSummary: A year ago, the answer to “which model should we use?” was simple: whichever frontier model topped the leaderboard that week. Then open models caught up. They cost a fraction as much, you could run them where you wanted, and your data stayed yours. Plenty of teams made the switch. Then they pointed those models at real work. An operator reports that R2 lost every route from R1, but ping across the link still works. A security team needs to find the three files in a million-line codebase most likely to hold a vulnerability. An observability team needs to spot the one interface that matters in a week of telemetry. This is where general-purpose models, open or closed, start to struggle. We think the next leap comes from a model that already knows the domain and then learns your customer. That second step runs on your data and your relationships, and it’s where partners lead. Today at Partner Summit, we’re introducing Cisco Model Foundry , a new platform service in Cisco Cloud Control. It gives partners access to Cisco’s purpose-built models and lets them serve those models in customer applications. When the use case calls for it, partners can also fine-tune the models on their customers’ own data, all in one place. Access Cisco’s domain models. Model Foundry opens up the models Cisco has built on four decades of networking, security, and operations knowledge. Several of them previously ran only inside our own products. Browse the catalog, open the Playground, paste in a real problem, and see how each model handles it before you commit. Put them to work. In Model Foundry, you create an API key, set an expiration, choose a model, and you’re connected. The API is OpenAI-compatible, so it plugs into the agents, tools, and workflows you already run. Administrators get tenant-scoped keys, per-model access controls, and full visibility into usage by model, key, and day. Tailor it when it counts. Fine-tuning means taking the knowledge that makes a network or a business unique and training the model on it. It’s built for the large volumes of data that partners and customers already have: configs, log messages, alerts, tickets, and agent traces from thousands of devices. Model Foundry handles the hard parts, from the GPUs to the training pipeline to built-in evaluation that runs the base and tuned models side by side. You see where tuning helped, and where it didn’t, before anything reaches production. Many partners don’t need to fine-tune to get value. A purpose-built Cisco model, served as-is, is built to outperform generic open models on domain work. Fine-tuning is there for the moments when “good” isn’t good enough.

historyItems.title: Verizon 提升前景，與亞馬遜簽署價值超過 20 億美元的交易
historyItems.summary: 作者：Kelly Cloonan Verizon Communications 再次上調了全年展望，因為該公司繼續為其後付費電話服務吸引新客戶。這家行動營運商也在周一表示，它與亞馬遜網路服務公司簽署了一項價值超過 20 億美元的協議，為代理商和生成人工智慧工作負載提供暗光纖。該協議是繼今年稍早與 Alphabet 旗下谷歌達成的類似協議之後達成的，該協議的估值超過 10 億美元。執行長 Dan Schulman 在與分析師的電話會議上表示：“這兩份合約是一個明確的信號，表明全球最大的人工智慧基礎設施建設者正在選擇 Verizon 作為戰略連接合作夥伴。”
historyItems.originalTitle: Verizon Lifts Outlook, Inks Amazon Deal Worth More Than $2 Billion
historyItems.originalSummary: By Kelly Cloonan Verizon Communications boosted its full-year outlook again as it continues to attract new customers for its postpaid phone service. The mobile carrier also on Monday said it signed a deal valued at more than $2 billion with Amazon Web Services to supply dark fiber for agentic and generative artificial-intelligence workloads. The agreement follows a similar deal earlier this year with Alphabet's Google, which was valued at more than $1 billion. "These two contracts are a clear signal that the largest builders of AI infrastructure in the world are choosing Verizon as a strategic connectivity partner," Chief Executive Dan Schulman said during a call with analysts. Schulman said Verizon is in talks with additional hyperscalers, neocloud providers and large enterprise clients to supply fiber connectivity. The company is also seeing momentum with several partners looking to use its network hubs for AI inference and edge computing, he said. Verizon gained a net 406,000 postpaid phone connections in the latest quarter, marking its strongest third-quarter performance on the closely watched metric in five years. Analysts polled by FactSet expected 195,300 postpaid phone net additions. Schulman said the company is gaining loyal, high-value customers as it shifts away from heavy subsidies to focus on other offerings, like its expanded loyalty program and its Simplicity plan, which it rolled out earlier this year. "We are not buying customers. We are winning them on revenue-positive terms and keeping them longer," Schulman said during a call with analysts. The postpaid strength helped Verizon post higher third-quarter profit and revenue. Schulman, who took the helm of Verizon last October, said the latest quarterly results are proof that it's evolved into a structurally different company. "Verizon is in a fundamentally better position operationally, financially and competitively," Schulman said. "Our transformation has taken root and our results show it." The latest results prompted the company to raise its full-year guidance for the third consecutive quarter. Verizon now expects adjusted earnings per share of $5.04 to $5.06 for the full year, compared with its prior view of $4.99 to $5.04, and now projects total full-year postpaid phone net additions of about 1.1 million to 1.2 million, up from a previous range of 875,000 to one million. The company also raised its projection for mobility and broadband service revenue growth to be in the upper half of its prior forecast of 2.5% to 3% for the year. Wall Street projects adjusted earnings of $5 per share and postpaid phone net additions of 975,000 for the year. Verizon's third-quarter profit came in at $5.3 billion, or $1.25 a share, compared with $5.06 billion, or $1.17 a share, a year earlier. Adjusted earnings per share were $1.31, compared with analyst estimates of $1.27. Revenue ticked up 1.5% to $34.3 billion, compared with analyst estimates of $34.77 billion. historyItems.originalTitle: Exclusive: Inside Unusual Machines' $52 Million Drone Battery Acquisition
historyItems.originalSummary: Order Helps Powerus Scale Production of Autonomous and Counter-Drone Systems to Meet Growing Demand ORLANDO, FL / ACCESS Newswire / October 22, 2026 / Unusual Machines, Inc. (NYSE American:UMAC), a leading manufacturer of NDAA-compliant drone components, today announced that it has received a $16.9 million purchase order from Powerus Corporation (Nasdaq:PUSA), a U.S. defense technology company focused on autonomous and unmanned systems. The order covers critical drone components, including motors, batteries, cameras, and video transmitters (VTX), for use across Powerus’s unmanned systems portfolio “The need for effective autonomous and counter-drone systems is growing rapidly, and Powerus is turning that urgency into action,” said Allan Evans, CEO of Unusual Machines. “This latest order builds on our partnership and underscores the importance of a reliable domestic supply chain behind those systems.” The order expands the companies’ commercial relationship as Powerus scales production to meet growing demand. It follows a previous order exceeding $5 million, announced in April 2026, and a $30 million strategic equity investment by Unusual Machines in Powerus, disclosed in June 2026. “The autonomous systems we deliver to our global customers support missions across incredibly complex and evolving operating environments,” said Brett Velicovich, Co-founder and President at Powerus. “Working with Unusual Machines in the U.S. means we can deliver critical products faster and more affordably to our customers, no matter where they are.” Unusual Machines is a leading provider of NDAA-compliant drone components, focused on building a domestic supply chain for the growing U.S. drone industry. The Company manufactures a broad portfolio of critical components, including flight controllers, electronic speed controllers, video systems, motors, FPV headsets, cameras and, following its acquisition of Upgrade Energy, batteries and power systems. Unusual Machines is expanding U.S. manufacturing to meet increasing demand from defense, enterprise, and commercial customers, while serving the consumer FPV market through its Fat Shark and Rotor Riot brands. According to Fact.MR, the U.S. drone components market represents a $3 billion to $5 billion opportunity. For more information, visit unusualmachines.com . Powerus Corporation (formerly Aureus Greenway Holdings Inc., Nasdaq:PUSA) builds and scales unified autonomous systems designed to move, protect, and sustain critical assets in high-risk environments, with capabilities spanning heavy-lift platforms, autonomous air systems, autonomous maritime systems, mission systems, training and support, and U.S.-based manufacturing. Powerus Corporation also owns and manages two golf courses in the Orlando, Florida region. On October 1, 2026, Powerus completed its previously announced merger with AGH; shares continue trading on Nasdaq under the symbol PUSA. Learn more at power.us. Investor: investors@unusualmachines.com Media: media@unusualmachines.com Investor Relations: Santosh Patel ir@power.us 404-314-8141

historyItems.originalTitle: Resideo Says ADI Spin-Off On Track for Late Summer, Gives 2Q26 Outlook - National Association of Wholesaler-Distributors
historyItems.originalSummary: Ariel Investments , an investment management company, released its "Ariel Appreciation Fund" Q3 2026 investor letter. A copy of the letter can be downloaded here . Copy main article 1st para. The Fund faced a challenging third quarter of 2026 as rising interest rates, higher energy prices, persistent inflation, and geopolitical uncertainty weighed on mid-cap equities, despite gains in the broader U.S. market. The Fund's Investor Class returned -3.90%, underperforming the Russell Midcap Value Index, which declined 1.98%, and the Russell Midcap Index, which fell 3.00%. Strong earnings, improved guidance, and better operating performance supported several holdings, while concerns about near-term demand, margins, and execution pressured others. The portfolio also experienced weakness in cruise-related and food-equipment businesses, reflecting softer travel trends, higher fuel costs, inflationary pressures, and investor concerns about near-term profitability. During the quarter, the Fund exited its position in a cruise operator and redeployed the proceeds into another major cruise company, sold an electronic-payments holding, and added exposure to a security, residential technology, and fire-safety distribution business following its spin-off. The Fund also received shares in a newly separated food-processing business. Looking ahead, Ariel expects volatility to persist as inflation, monetary policy, and economic growth remain uncertain. The firm views market dislocations as opportunities to acquire quality businesses trading below intrinsic value, emphasizing durable competitive advantages, strong balance sheets, cash generation, and long-term earnings potential. In addition, please check the Fund's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.

historyItems.originalTitle: Nuclear Fuel Capacity Expands via Centrus Energy Westerman Acquisition
historyItems.originalSummary: Interested in Centrus Energy Corp.? Here are five stocks we like better. Centrus Energy completed a $116 million acquisition of Westerman Holdings on Oct. 16 to secure its primary centrifuge-component manufacturing supply chain. Despite falling nearly 55% year-to-date on dilution concerns from a $500 million stock offering, Centrus holds a $3.7 billion uranium enrichment backlog and a $900 million Department of Energy contract. Zacks Research upgraded Centrus to Strong-Buy with a consensus price target near $225, implying over 100% upside as nuclear fuel demand grows.

historyItems.originalTitle: AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) Stock Dropped, So What Is Driving Attention Now?

For investors, the story around AST SpaceMobile has been far more volatile than the service roadmap. The share price has fallen 5.21% over the last session, is down 39.13% over the past month and 53.55% year to date, yet the three year total shareholder return is extremely high. This suggests long term backers have already experienced very large gains even as recent selling points to rising concern about execution risk and timing around this rollout.

historyItems.title: SpaceX 正在洽談接入 80,000 個蜂窩基地台的新網絡
historyItems.summary: Investing.com—彭博新聞社報導，SpaceX 正在討論獲得美國至少 80,000 個蜂窩基地台的接入權，該公司股價週五在美國盤前交易中上漲超過 2%。彭博社報道稱，此舉將標誌著朝著建立第四家全國性無線營運商邁出了具體的一步。據稱，這家衛星巨頭正在與包括 Crown Castle International Corp （NYSE：CCI）在內的主要塔營運商進行談判，以收集補充其軌道網路所需的實體基礎設施。
historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX in Talks to Access 80,000 Cell Sites for New Network
historyItems.originalSummary: Investing.com -- SpaceX shares rose by more than 2% in premarket U.S. trading on Friday after Bloomberg News reported that the rocket company is in discussions to secure access to at least 80,000 cell sites across the United States. Bloomberg reported that the move would signal a concrete step toward establishing a fourth nationwide wireless carrier. The satellite giant is said to be negotiating with major tower operators, including Crown Castle International Corp (NYSE:CCI), as it gathers the physical infrastructure required to complement its orbital network. Crown Castle shares surged by more than 7% premarket.

historyItems.originalTitle: Bloom Energy Lifts Outlook, Logs Higher Profit
historyItems.originalSummary: By Katherine Hamilton Deckers Outdoor cut its outlook, citing a highly promotional shoe industry. Shares slid 7% to $79.15 in after-hours trading Thursday. Sallie Mae lowered its outlook after logging higher charge-offs in the latest quarter. The stock declined 5% to $21.76. Western Digital's latest earnings report wasn't enough to get the stock back on track after investors sold off AI shares during day trading. Shares were down 5% to $336.50 after the bell. Bloom Energy had a negative cash flow in the latest quarter as it continued to spend heavily. The stock fell 5% to $206.21. Write to Katherine Hamilton at katherine.hamilton@wsj.com (END) Dow Jones Newswires 10-22-26 1912ET
